name: codex-quota-hud
description: Shows a local black-and-green quota HUD only while Codex is in use.

interface.shortDescription: Show weekly Codex quota only while Codex has focus.
interface.longDescription: Starts a black-and-green Windows quota HUD with full and compact one-line modes. It hides when you switch away from Codex, reappears when you return, and reads rate limits through the local Codex CLI App Server.
